title: How Low-Cost Carrier Withdrawal Affects Airfares in U.S. Domestic Markets
description: Union College economics honors thesis examining how low-cost carrier exits affect competition and pricing. Uses DOT DB1B fare data and a difference-in-differences model to estimate a 7.15% increase in fares on Albany routes following a carrier's exit.

title: Industry Report: U.S. Commercial Aviation
description: Examines competition in the U.S. domestic airline industry through an industrial organization framework. Analyzes market concentration, airline cost structures, and regulation to assess how consolidation shapes competition.

title: Do NHL Players Outperform in Contract Years?
description: Investigates whether NHL players perform better in the final year of their contracts. Uses fixed-effects regressions on skater and goalie panel data from 2008–2024, finding no statistically significant evidence of a contract-year performance increase.
